name: Ratingen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Ratingen (a red lion on white above a white wheel on red).
history: The city of Ratingen was most recently granted arms, a seal and a flag on 3 October 1972; the flag is striped red, white and red in the ratio 1:3:1 and shows the city arms in the middle of the white stripe.
